call_points.text: US sports nets business is described as on track after the tariff resolution, with orders at base rates from all major customers.
Geosynthetics is said to have continued strong topline and profit growth in FY2026, led by landfill and lining and slope protection.
Geosynthetics carries a strong order book that the filing says gives visibility for next year, without a value.
The OTS acquisition delivered planned financial performance in 2025 and is ROCE and EPS positive for GTFL.
The company cites 101 patents filed and 29 granted, with 20,000 SKUs across its technical textile range.
The deck describes the company as debt free with an ICRA AA+ long-term rating.
The filing flags low global salmon supply growth expected in 2026.
